hero.alt: SysAdminDoc. Fix what bugs you, keep control of the rest. Free apps, extensions and utilities for Windows, Android and the browser.

proof.method: Summed GitHub release asset downloads across the public repositories: 99,580 on 2026-09-29 (228 public repos, 206 not forks). The 100,000+ headline was set by hand that day, 420 ahead of the count, which was climbing about 6,000 a day.

flagships.name: OpenTasker
flagships.imageAlt: OpenTasker: put your phone on autopilot and read every rule. Three phone screens showing profiles, tasks and a flow.
flagships.pitch: Phone automation in the spirit of Tasker, fully open source. Readable rules, 78 built-in actions, and all of it runs on your phone.

flagships.name: NVMe Driver Patcher
flagships.imageAlt: NVMe Driver Patcher: native NVMe on Windows 11, skipping the SCSI layer. Single exe, GUI and CLI, MSI for fleets.
flagships.pitch: Switches Windows 11 to the native NVMe driver from Server 2025. It checks your system before it changes anything and keeps a clean way back.

flagships.name: Hushfeed
flagships.imageAlt: Hushfeed: take back your feed. Morphe patches for TikTok with feed filters, gesture guards, playback and download controls.
flagships.pitch: A patch bundle for TikTok. Fewer accidental taps, less noise, and more say over your feed and your downloads.

flagships.name: Hushfacebook
flagships.imageAlt: Hushfacebook: keep the people, cut the noise. Morphe patches for Facebook that clear sponsored clutter, Reels and Stories.
flagships.pitch: A patch bundle for Facebook. Keeps your friends in the feed and clears out the ads, Reels and Stories clutter.

flagships.name: AppManagerNG
flagships.imageAlt: AppManagerNG: know what is installed, control what it can do. Phone screens showing the app list and permission inspector.
flagships.pitch: See every app on your phone and what it can reach. Debloat, freeze and back up from one place, with or without root.

flagships.name: Video Subtitle Remover
flagships.imageAlt: Video Subtitle Remover Pro: remove subtitles, keep the frame. The desktop app cleaning burned-in text from a video.
flagships.pitch: Takes burned-in subtitles and on-screen text out of video, right on your PC. You review each text track before anything is removed.

flagships.name: DeepPurge
flagships.imageAlt: DeepPurge: see what stays, control what goes. The Windows uninstaller listing installed programs.
flagships.pitch: An uninstaller that shows you what it's about to remove before it does, and keeps a recovery trail when it's done.

flagships.name: Openshop
flagships.imageAlt: Openshop: a full image studio right in your browser. Layers, selections, PSD interchange and local export.
flagships.pitch: A full image editor in a browser tab, with layers and PSD support. No signup, and your files stay on your machine.
